post.description: For 20 seconds after rotation, up to two retries return the identical pair only while the direct successor and parent remain valid and the account is active. Additional retries are rejected without revoking the valid child. Rotation does not extend the refresh deadline. After the window reuse revokes the token family; legacy unlinked tokens can revoke all sessions. A stolen token can also be replayed during the window.

info.title: Gradix API
info.description: Decimal inputs are strings. Scale 3: trip quantity/weighQty, fuel liters, stock qty and project quantities; scale 2: monetary values, user hourlyRate and location accuracyM; scale 1: diary temperatures; scale 7: coordinates including geofence queries. Excess significant fractional digits are rejected with VALIDATION_FAILED (HTTP 400); trailing zeros are allowed. Excess scale is checked before processing any sync batch items. Other sync errors remain per-item in the HTTP 200 batch result. Existing data and computed amounts are not rewritten.
